_comment: Spec 14 §2's `memory-quality` gate thresholds (open question O2/O3's memory-router half; spec 08 §7's `[OPEN]` target P/R), consumed by `crates/xtask/src/memory_bench/gate.rs`. Versioned deliberately: a retune is a reviewable diff with a stated justification, never an edited literal in code (mirrors T12-05's search-gate precedent).
derivation: Re-derived (T14-09) after `crates/generate::chat_template::render` replaced `llama-cpp-2::apply_chat_template` for every catalog entry, including the shipped default: Gemma 4 E2B now renders through its own real, native embedded template (a `minijinja` render of the raw GGUF `tokenizer.chat_template`, system turn included) instead of T14-07's `chat_template_override="gemma"` workaround, which forced the vendored llama.cpp's older Gemma 1-3 formatter and merged the system turn into the first user turn. Two independent runs of the identical new default (same model, corpus, harness, greedy sampling) were measured, not one, because the first re-run done purely to sanity-check the gate produced *different* numbers from the first: run 1 (fixtures/memory/baseline/run-gemma-4-e2b-native-template.json) precision=0.6486/recall=0.5455/f1=0.5926/exact_match_rate=0.5238; run 2 (run-gemma-4-e2b-native-template-2.json) precision=0.6757/recall=0.5682/f1=0.6173/exact_match_rate=0.5476. This is real, measured run-to-run variance under nominally deterministic greedy decoding (~0.03 precision, ~0.02 recall swing between two back-to-back runs of the same binary/weights/corpus) -- consistent with, and now directly quantifying, what this file's prior derivation already flagged qualitatively as 'cross-host Metal/BLAS numeric variance' (this host: Apple M5 Pro, Metal backend, confirmed via `ggml_metal_device_init` in the real-inference test log). Both runs are measurably *lower* than the override-path run this replaces (precision=0.6667, recall=0.6364, f1=0.6512) -- disclosed as measured, not smoothed into a flattering number: ADR-0006 only speculated T14-09 might unlock a higher ceiling by exercising Gemma 4's native system-role support ('possibly... a higher real ceiling'), never a guarantee, and neither real run bears that out for this router's specific system prompt/few-shot wording (see this ADR's own Amendment section for the full disclosure and a plausible reason). The mechanism generalizing -- no per-model override needed -- is T14-09's actual scope; a quality guarantee is not. These floors sit a real margin below the *lower* of the two runs (precision -0.049 vs run 1, -0.076 vs run 2; recall -0.045 vs run 1, -0.068 vs run 2) -- wide enough to comfortably absorb the observed run-to-run spread itself (~0.027 precision, ~0.023 recall) rather than sitting only marginally below a single sample, which a third run could plausibly have undercut. A materially worse run must still fail. Both Qwen ChatML entries were independently re-measured once each under the same new rendering path as a regression check (not because their thresholds moved -- they are covered by the same floors as the default entry, per this file's own single-threshold-set design): qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-gguf-q4km precision=0.3590/recall=0.3182/f1=0.3373 (fixtures/memory/baseline/run-qwen05-native-template.json) against the round-one recorded 0.3784/0.3182/0.3457 (run.json) -- recall and exact_match_rate identical, precision/f1 within ~0.02, no material regression; qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct-gguf-q4km precision=0.3571/recall=0.3409/f1=0.3488 (run-qwen15-native-template.json) against 0.3659/0.3409/0.3529 (run-1.5b.json) -- same pattern. All prior run files (run.json, run-1.5b.json, run-gemma-4-e2b.json) are kept on disk untouched as real historical evidence, per this project's 'do not rewrite prior progress evidence' rule -- superseded as the *current* baseline, not deleted. Raising these floors is future work (better prompting tuned for the native system-role turn, more fixture coverage, router_version-tracked confidence-weight tuning per spec 08 §2, or averaging multiple runs to shrink the Metal-variance margin itself); lowering them further requires a new measured regression, documented here.
derived_from: fixtures/memory/baseline/run-gemma-4-e2b-native-template.json and run-gemma-4-e2b-native-template-2.json (gemma-4-e2b-it-gguf-q4-0, greedy, raw_chat_template_override=None, native template via minijinja, T14-09; two runs, floors set below the lower)
